About me

Practical engineering, from model to product.

I’m a Computer Science graduate specializing in Artificial Intelligence, with a strong interest in building end-to-end AI applications that solve practical problems.

My work spans Computer Vision, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Natural Language Processing, Data Analytics, and Agentic AI. I enjoy taking projects beyond model development by connecting AI models and intelligent agents with APIs, databases, dashboards, and automation workflows to create complete, usable systems.

Through academic projects and hands-on training, I’ve worked on real-time safety monitoring, driver behavior analysis, sports analytics, predictive modeling, interactive business dashboards, and AI-powered assistants.

I value practical engineering, measurable improvements, and systems that are not only intelligent but also useful, maintainable, and ready to be integrated into real workflows.

I’m continuously exploring better ways to build, evaluate, and deploy AI solutions.
